
```{r make figure directory}
# make figure directory
if (!dir.exists("Figures")) {
  dir.create("Figures")
}
```

```{r import ecdf functions}
# find all ecdf_*.rds files in the directory
ecdf_files <- list.files(path = file.path(DATA_ROOT, "Reference_Bias/"), pattern = "ecdf_.*\\.rds", full.names = TRUE)

# create a list to store the ecdf functions
ecdf_list <- list()
# loop through the files and read the ecdf functions
for (file in ecdf_files) {
  # extract the name of the file without the path and extension
  file_name <- gsub("ecdf_|\\.rds", "", basename(file))
  # read the ecdf function from the file
  ecdf_list[[file_name]] <- readRDS(file)
}

# check the names of the ecdf functions
ecdf_names <- names(ecdf_list)

# remove ".parsed.bed" from the names
ecdf_names <- gsub("\\.parsed\\.bed.gz", "", ecdf_names)

# replace "true-dip.CC" with "CC"
#ecdf_names <- gsub("true-dip.CC", "true-dip", ecdf_names)

# parse name to get {Genome}.{Cross} split by "."
Genome <- str_split(ecdf_names, "_", simplify = TRUE)[,1]
Cross <- str_split(ecdf_names, "_", simplify = TRUE)[,2]
```

```{r process ecdf functions to generate dataframe}
lapply(
  1:length(ecdf_list),
  function(I) data.frame(
              referenceFraction=seq(0,1,0.01),
              percentile=unlist(lapply(seq(0,1,0.01), function(X) ecdf_list[[I]](X))),
              Genome=Genome[I],
              Cross=Cross[I]
            )
) %>% bind_rows() -> ReferenceFraction_Percentile_Data


ReferenceFraction_Percentile_Data$Genome <- gsub("Pangenome", "Pangenome", ReferenceFraction_Percentile_Data$Genome)
ReferenceFraction_Percentile_Data$Genome <- gsub("BWA", "mm10", ReferenceFraction_Percentile_Data$Genome)

# Correct the Cross names, replace "_" with "/"
ReferenceFraction_Percentile_Data$Cross <- gsub("-", "x", ReferenceFraction_Percentile_Data$Cross)
```

```{r calculate referencebias as percentile differences}
calculate_percentile_difference <- function(REFERENCEFRACTION, GENOME, CROSS) {
  
  subset(
    ReferenceFraction_Percentile_Data,
    Genome == GENOME &
      Cross == CROSS &
      referenceFraction == REFERENCEFRACTION
  )$percentile -> PERCENT
  
  1 - PERCENT
}

REFERENCEFRACTIONS <- sprintf("%.1f", seq(0.5, 0.95, by = 0.05))

# Loop through the unique values of Cross, Genome, and referenceFraction
percentile_differences <- lapply(
  unique(ReferenceFraction_Percentile_Data$Cross),
  function(CROSS) {
    lapply(
      unique(ReferenceFraction_Percentile_Data$Genome),
      function(GENOME) {
        lapply(
          REFERENCEFRACTIONS,
          function(REFERENCEFRACTION) {
            data.frame(
              Cross = CROSS,
              Genome = GENOME,
              referenceFraction = REFERENCEFRACTION,
              ReferenceBias = calculate_percentile_difference(REFERENCEFRACTION, GENOME, CROSS)
            )
          }
        ) %>% bind_rows()
      }
    ) %>% bind_rows()
  }
) %>% bind_rows()
```

```{r plot reference bias by reference fraction, include=TRUE, fig.width=4, fig.height=4}
)

  percentile_differences,
  aes(x = referenceFraction_plot, y = ReferenceBias, color = Genome)

    x = "Reference fraction",
```

```{r per-F1 fold reduction across thresholds}
# Reshape wide: one row per (file, threshold) with BWA and Pangenome side by side
threshold_wide <- dcast(
    setDT(reference_fraction_threshold_counts),
    file + referenceFraction ~ Genome,
    value.var = "n_sites_above_threshold"
)

# Per-F1 ratio
threshold_wide[, ratio := BWA / Pangenome]

# Median across the 20 F1 pairs at each threshold
threshold_wide[
    ,
    .(n_F1 = .N,
      median_BWA   = median(BWA),
      median_Pan   = median(Pangenome),
      median_ratio = median(ratio),
      mean_ratio   = mean(ratio),
      sd_ratio     = sd(ratio)),
    by = referenceFraction
][order(referenceFraction)]
```

```{r perform paired Wilcoxon test comparing mm10 and Pangenome reference bias}
percentile_differences_for_test <- percentile_differences %>%
  group_by(Cross, Genome, referenceFraction) %>%
  summarise(
    ReferenceBias = mean(ReferenceBias),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

percentile_differences_wide <- percentile_differences_for_test %>%
  dplyr::select(Cross, Genome, referenceFraction, ReferenceBias) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Genome,
    values_from = ReferenceBias
  )

percentile_differences_wide$d <- percentile_differences_wide$mm10 -
  percentile_differences_wide$Pangenome

wilcox_results <- percentile_differences_wide %>%
  group_by(referenceFraction) %>%
  summarise(
    n = sum(!is.na(mm10) & !is.na(Pangenome)),
    meanDifference = mean(d, na.rm = TRUE),
    sdDifference = sd(d, na.rm = TRUE),
    medianDifference = median(d, na.rm = TRUE),
    p_value = wilcox.test(
      mm10,
      Pangenome,
      paired = TRUE,
      exact = TRUE,
      alternative = "two.sided"
    )$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

wilcox_results$padj_BH <- p.adjust(wilcox_results$p_value, method = "BH")

wilcox_results
```

```{r perform paired exact randomization test ecdf}

# Exact paired randomization test.
# For each Cross, either keep the observed Pangenome - mm10 ECDF difference
# or flip its sign. This enumerates all 2^n paired label swaps.

spread(ReferenceFraction_Percentile_Data, referenceFraction, percentile) -> DATA.wide

referenceFraction_columns <- setdiff(colnames(DATA.wide), c("Genome", "Cross"))
referenceFraction_columns <- referenceFraction_columns[order(as.numeric(referenceFraction_columns))]

Crosses <- unique(DATA.wide$Cross)

lapply(
  Crosses,
  function(CROSS) {
    
    Pangenome_Row <- subset(DATA.wide, Cross == CROSS & Genome == "Pangenome")
    mm10_Row <- subset(DATA.wide, Cross == CROSS & Genome == "mm10")
    
    if (nrow(Pangenome_Row) != 1 | nrow(mm10_Row) != 1) {
      stop(paste0("Expected exactly one Pangenome row and one mm10 row for Cross: ", CROSS))
    }
    
    as.numeric(unlist(Pangenome_Row[, referenceFraction_columns])) -
      as.numeric(unlist(mm10_Row[, referenceFraction_columns]))
  }
) %>% do.call(rbind, .) -> Difference_Matrix

n_pairs <- nrow(Difference_Matrix)

max_mm10 <- max(abs(colMeans(Difference_Matrix)))

NumberOfIterations <- 2^n_pairs
print(NumberOfIterations)

chunk_size <- 50000
n_chunks <- ceiling(NumberOfIterations / chunk_size)

Randomization_Results <- vector("list", n_chunks)
extreme_count <- 0
tolerance <- sqrt(.Machine$double.eps)

for (chunk in seq_len(n_chunks)) {
  
  start_index <- (chunk - 1) * chunk_size
  end_index <- min(chunk * chunk_size - 1, NumberOfIterations - 1)
  ids <- start_index:end_index
  
  signs <- sapply(
    seq_len(n_pairs),
    function(BIT) {
      ifelse(bitwAnd(ids, bitwShiftL(1L, BIT - 1L)) == 0, -1, 1)
    }
  )
  
  permuted_delta <- signs %*% Difference_Matrix / n_pairs
  permuted_max <- apply(abs(permuted_delta), 1, max)
  
  extreme_count <- extreme_count + sum(permuted_max >= (max_mm10 - tolerance))
  
  Randomization_Results[[chunk]] <- data.frame(
    iteration = ids + 1,
    max_mm10 = permuted_max
  )
}

Randomization_Results <- bind_rows(Randomization_Results)

p_value_mm10 <- extreme_count / NumberOfIterations

print(paste0("exact paired randomization p-value mm10: ", p_value_mm10))

```

```{r estimate significance of max delta cumulative fraction, include=TRUE, fig.width=2.5, fig.height=2.25}
max( abs(subset(ReferenceFraction_Delta_Cumulative_Fraction, Genome=="mm10")$deltaCumulativeFraction) )->max_mm10

p_value_mm10 <- mean(Randomization_Results$max_mm10 >= (max_mm10 - sqrt(.Machine$double.eps)))

print(paste0("p-value mm10: ", p_value_mm10))

ggplot(Randomization_Results, aes(x=max_mm10)) +
  geom_histogram(fill="grey", alpha=0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = max_mm10, linetype = "dashed", color = "#c03a46", linewidth=0.5) +

  labs(x="ks-statistic", y="Count") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand=c(0,0), limits=c(0,max(Randomization_Results$max_mm10, max_mm10)*1.1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand=c(0,0), limits=c(0, 100)) +
  annotate("text", x=max(Randomization_Results$max_mm10, max_mm10)*.75, y=90, label=paste0("p-value: ", round(p_value_mm10, 4)), color="#c03a46", size=3.5) -> p6
```

```{r plot intervals epdf, include=TRUE, fig.width=2.5, fig.height=2.25}
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  labs(x="Reference fraction", y="Probability") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#c03a46", "#447ead")) -> p9

p9

# save as png and as svg
ggsave("Figures/ReferenceAlignmentBias_EPDFs.png", plot=p9, width=2.5, height=5, dpi=300)
```
